releaseNotes: Neon Remote Engine Integration: Added high-performance, real-time Screen Mirroring with adaptive bitrate and smooth buffer management.
Seamless Remote Access: Implemented stable 3-Way SSH Tunneling (Serveo) for reliable and high-speed remote connections.
Enterprise File Manager: Advanced storage management with Scoped Storage (OBB/Data) support, integrated Code Editor, and native ZIP archive handling.
Live Interactive Terminal: Added a professional web-based command-line interface with real-time logging and system control.
Web Panel UI Redesign: Upgraded repository interface with a modern Cyberpunk theme, Live Search functionality, and interactive detail popups.
Terminal Engine Update: Full support for both Shizuku and iAdb elevated privileges.
Fix Refresh Rate Display: Implemented Developer Settings bypass combined with SurfaceFlinger parcel calls to force overlay across all Android 11+ OEM devices.
New 'Game Driver Opt-In' Toggle: Force the Android graphics engine to deploy native Game Drivers globally.
New 'Disable Untrusted Touches' Toggle: Fixes the notorious input delay/touch blocking when overlay apps (like Discord/Messenger bubbles) are active.
New 'AFK Cafe Mode' Toggle: Allow infinite screen timeout (up to 24 Days) for heavy auto-grinding games.
